externalId.description: The external id (foreign key). Must not exceed 255 characters.

expiration.description: The timestamp when this participation will expire. Expiration never happens if this value is *null*. Expiration means that the user will no longer able to access it.

activated.description: True if this participation has been activated and can be used

activitiesTotal.description: The total number of activities. This includes optional activities.

accessLink.description: A link to access this particular participation. The link requires the user to login. Users that access the platform the first time must set a password. This value is null if this participation is not activated. *This link is sensitive. Make sure that only authorized  users can access it*.

projectId.description: The id of the project this participation belongs to

errorMessage.description: An optional error message that may describe why the participation is in error state.

firstAccess.description: The timestamp when the participant accessed the project for the first time. This value can be null

firstActivation.description: The timestamp when this participation was first activated. This value can be null

firstCompleted.description: The timestamp when the participant completed their participation the first time. This value can be null

firstMail.description: The timestamp when the first email was sent to this participant. This value can be null

id.description: Unique identifier representing this participation. Id numbers are never reused

inError.description: True if this participation is in an error state. The user is not able to access participations that are in error state.

userId.description: The id of the user this participation belongs to

lastAccess.description: The timestamp when the participant accessed the project the last time. This value can be null

lastActivation.description: The timestamp when this participation was last activated. This value can be null

lastMail.description: The timestamp when the last mail was sent to this participant. This value can be null

customFields.description: The custom fields of this participation, if any

completionStatus.description: The completion status. Can be one of the following:

waitlistSeat.description: The seat number of a waitlist participation. The first in queue has seat number 0. Not present when participation is not a WAITLIST participation.

reservationId.description: The reserved slots reservation id. Not present when reservation id was not set.

reservationName.description: The reserved slots reservation name. Not present when reservation id was not set.

primaryEmail.description: The primary email for the user. Used for communication from the platform.

username.description: A username for the user. The username is case sensitive and must be unique.

externalId.description: The external id (foreign key). Must not exceed 255 characters.

firstName.description: The first (given) name of the user

displayName.description: The name shown when the user is listed

lastName.description: The last name (surname) of the user

manager.description: The user's manager. The manager must be a user in the same organization as the user.

homeOrg.description: The primary organization for the user. Must match the id of an Organization Unit.

locale.description: The user's preferred language/locale setting. Affects date and number formatting.

hardLock.description: True if the user should be locked from the system

customFields.description: The custom fields the needs to be added, updated or removed (set value to null).

thumbnailPhoto.description: A base64 encoded jpeg or png image

extid.description: An optional external id for the participation

email.description: The email of the user. If no user exists with the specified email a user will be created with default values and the specified email.

username.description: A username. Note that user names are case sensitive

activate.description: Should participant be activated after being created. It will be only activated if caller have sufficient permissions to do that

id.description: Unique identifier representing a specific organization unit. Id numbers are never reused.

parentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent or *null* if there is no parent.

customFields.description: The custom fields of this organization unit, if any

disabled.description: True if the organization is disabled.

demo.description: True if the organization is a demo.

home.description: True if the organization is the home organization
